output_json.diff_review: Non-POV diff touches one product file and two test files. Product change (StringLookupFactory.java): in the default-lookups loop, it skips DNS/SCRIPT/URL via isDefaultDisabledLookup(). This is the appropriate, security-correct minimal fix — the vulnerable ScriptStringLookup class and all lookups still exist and can be opted into explicitly via interpolatorStringLookup(map, null, true); functionality is not removed, only disabled-by-default. Safe lookups (base64, const, date, env, file, java, localhost, properties, resourceBundle, sys, urlDecoder/urlEncoder, xml) remain enabled. Test changes update StringLookupFactoryTest.assertDefaultKeys to assert dns/script/url are absent and add a CWE-094 regression asserting the payload is left literal; StringSubstitutorWithInterpolatorStringLookupTest is updated so dns/javascript functional tests explicitly enable their lookup (createInterpolatorWith helper) and adds a default-does-not-enable-script test. The POV files (Pov.java/run.sh/cp.txt) are unchanged by the patch — the patch does not weaken or disable the POV. No API signatures changed; the only behavioral change is the intended secure default.
output_json.pov_result: Independently reran `bash .security-pipeline/pov/run.sh` via the Docker wrapper against the patched worktree: output was `result : ${script:javascript:new java.lang.String('POV_RCE_' + (7 * 191))}` and `NOT VULNERABLE: script lookup did not execute the payload.` with exit code 1. The pre-patch orchestrator log shows the same POV exited 0 with `result : POV_RCE_1337` / `VULNERABLE`, confirming the vulnerability was real and is now fixed.
output_json.regression_result: Reran focused regression via Docker wrapper: `mvn -B -Drat.skip=true -Dtest=StringLookupFactoryTest,StringSubstitutorWithInterpolatorStringLookupTest,InterpolatorStringLookupTest,ScriptStringLookupTest test` → BUILD SUCCESS, 38 tests, 0 failures/0 errors (ScriptStringLookupTest still passes, confirming script-lookup functionality is preserved when explicitly used). Orchestrator's full-suite run (`mvn -B -Drat.skip=true test`) also passed: 1222 tests, 0 failures/0 errors, 2 skipped.
output_json.summary: The patch fixes CVE-2022-42889 / CWE-094 (Text4Shell) minimally and correctly by excluding the dangerous SCRIPT, DNS, and URL lookups from the default interpolator built by StringLookupFactory.addDefaultStringLookups() (via a new isDefaultDisabledLookup helper), mirroring the upstream commons-text 1.10.0 fix. The attacker-controlled ${script:javascript:...} payload is now left unresolved instead of being evaluated by the Nashorn ScriptEngine. POV no longer reproduces and regressions pass.
